description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for setting wireless network configurations such as Wi-Fi settings, WPS, MAC filtering, and network parameters on an XB6 platform. It includes functionality for managing Wi-Fi radio states, security settings, MAC filters, and coordination with session authentications.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum based on length and Luhn algorithm for 8-digit pins.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Checks if filter parameters contain only printable characters and valid MAC addresses.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies configuration to a specific SSID by setting relevant TR-069 parameters.
